title: Basic Calculator Interface & Addition/Subtraction
user_story: As a user, I want to enter two numbers and select addition or subtraction, so that I can quickly calculate basic sums and differences in my browser.
acceptance_criteria: The page displays input fields for two numbers and buttons for plus (+) and minus (-).
Entering valid numbers and clicking the plus button shows the correct sum on the screen.
Entering valid numbers and clicking the minus button shows the correct difference on the screen.
Entering non-numeric characters triggers a clear error message without breaking the interface.

title: Multiplication & Division Operations
user_story: As a user, I want to multiply or divide two numbers, so that I can handle more complex calculations without leaving the app.
acceptance_criteria: The interface includes buttons for multiplication (*) and division (/).
Clicking the multiplication button with valid numbers displays the correct product.
Clicking the division button with a non-zero divisor displays the correct quotient, rounded to two decimal places if necessary.
Attempting division by zero shows a clear 'Cannot divide by zero' error message instead of crashing or showing invalid results.

title: Clear Function & Input Validation
user_story: As a user, I want to clear my inputs and results at any time, so that I can start a new calculation without refreshing the page.
acceptance_criteria: A 'Clear' button is visible on the interface next to the operation buttons.
Clicking Clear resets all input fields to empty and removes any displayed result or error message.
The app validates that inputs are numeric before processing, showing an error for letters or special characters.
Decimal numbers are accepted and calculated correctly across all operations.
